svg.title: Test fee sensitivity before choosing a market
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-jurisdiction-fee-caps; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Test fee sensitivity before choosing a market; subtitle: Hypothetical ceilings, not a state-law comparison; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Percent of a $50,000 claimant recovery. A-D are fictional jurisdictions; these values assert no actual statutory cap.; caption: A percentage ceiling alone does not establish an enforceable agreement; claim type, timing, permitted services and the compensation base also matter.; stages: label: Hypothetical A; value: 5% / $2,500; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Assumed ceiling only; verify the governing sale procedure and any waiting period.; label: Hypothetical B; value: 10% / $5,000; numeric value: 10.0; detail: Assumed ceiling, not a recommendation to charge the maximum.; label: Hypothetical C; value: 15% / $7,500; numeric value: 15.0; detail: Assumed ceiling; reimbursed expenses may count toward allowed compensation.; label: Hypothetical D; value: 20% / $10,000; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Assumed ceiling; legal representation and assignment restrictions remain separate questions.
